items.source: The @Query annotation allows you to specify a custom RowMapper or ResultSetExtractor to use. The attributes rowMapperClass and resultSetExtractorClass allow you to specify classes to use, which will get instantiated using a default constructor. Alternatively you may set rowMapperRef or resultSetExtractorRef to a bean name from your Spring application context.
items.translation:
`@Query` 注解允许您指定要使用的自定义 `RowMapper` 或 `ResultSetExtractor`。  
属性 `rowMapperClass` 和 `resultSetExtractorClass` 可用于指定要使用的类，这些类将通过默认构造函数进行实例化。  
或者，您可以将 `rowMapperRef` 或 `resultSetExtractorRef` 设置为 Spring 应用程序上下文中的 Bean 名称。

items.source: Properties one-to-one relationships must have their name prefixed by the name of the relationship plus _. For example if the User from the example above has an address with the property city the column for that city must be labeled address_city.
items.translation: 一对一关系的属性名称必须以关系名称加上_作为前缀。例如，如果上述示例中的User具有一个address属性，且该地址包含city属性，则对应city的列必须标记为address_city。

items.source: If no query is given in an annotation as described in the previous section Spring Data JDBC will try to locate a named query. There are two ways how the name of the query can be determined. The default is to take the domain class of the query, i.e. the aggregate root of the repository, take its simple name and append the name of the method separated by a .. Alternatively the @Query annotation has a name attribute which can be used to specify the name of a query to be looked up.
items.translation: 如果注解中未提供查询（如上一节所述），Spring Data JDBC 将尝试查找命名查询。 确定查询名称有两种方式。 默认情况下，采用查询的领域类（即仓库的聚合根）的简单名称，并追加方法名，两者之间用.分隔。 或者，可以使用@Query注解的name属性来指定要查找的查询名称。

items.source: For converting the query result into entities the same RowMapper is used by default as for the queries Spring Data JDBC generates itself. The query you provide must match the format the RowMapper expects. Columns for all properties that are used in the constructor of an entity must be provided. Columns for properties that get set via setter, wither or field access are optional. Properties that don’t have a matching column in the result will not be set. The query is used for populating the aggregate root, embedded entities and one-to-one relationships including arrays of primitive types which get stored and loaded as SQL-array-types. Separate queries are generated for maps, lists, sets and arrays of entities.
items.translation: 将查询结果转换为实体时，默认使用与 Spring Data JDBC 自身生成的查询相同的 `RowMapper`。您提供的查询必须符合 `RowMapper` 期望的格式。必须提供实体构造函数中所有属性对应的列。通过 setter、wither 或字段访问方式设置的属性对应的列为可选。结果集中没有匹配列的属性将不会被设置。该查询用于填充聚合根、嵌入实体以及一对一关系，包括作为 SQL 数组类型存储和加载的原生类型数组。对于映射、列表、集合和实体数组，会生成单独的查询。

items.source: The entity classes in the QueryMappingConfiguration are iterated until one is found that is a superclass or interface of the return type in question. The RowMapper registered for that class is used.
items.translation:
`QueryMappingConfiguration` 中的实体类会被遍历，直到找到一个是目标返回类型的超类或接口的类为止。  
将为此类注册的 `RowMapper` 将被使用。

items.translation: JDBC 模块支持在 `@Query` 注解中手动将查询定义为字符串，或在属性文件中将其定义为命名查询。

items.source: The stream contains an open connection to the database. To avoid memory leaks, that connection needs to be closed eventually, by closing the stream. The recommended way to do that is a try-with-resource clause. It also means that, once the connection to the database is closed, the stream cannot obtain further elements and likely throws an exception.
items.translation: 流包含一个指向数据库的开放连接。为避免内存泄漏，最终需要通过关闭流来关闭该连接。推荐的做法是使用 try-with-resource 语句。这也意味着，一旦数据库连接被关闭，流将无法获取更多元素，并很可能抛出异常。

Deriving a query from the name of the method is currently limited to simple properties, that means properties present in the aggregate root directly.
Also, only select queries are supported by this approach.

items.source:
Queries may contain SpEL expressions.
There are two variants that are evaluated differently.

查询可能包含 SpEL 表达式。
有两种变体，它们的评估方式不同。

items.source: The other variant can be used anywhere in the query and the result of evaluating the query will replace the expression in the query string.

items.source: Named queries are handled in the same way as queries provided by annotation.
items.translation: 命名查询的处理方式与通过注解提供的查询相同。

items.source:
When you specify Stream as the return type of a query method, Spring Data JDBC returns elements as soon as they become available.
When dealing with large amounts of data this is suitable for reducing latency and memory requirements.
items.translation: 当您将查询方法的返回类型指定为 Stream 时，Spring Data JDBC 会立即返回可用的元素。在处理大量数据时，这种方式有助于降低延迟并减少内存需求。

items.source: Instead, the query is expected to return a single row with a single column, and a conversion to the return type is applied to that value.
items.translation: 相反，预期查询将返回包含单列的单行数据，并对该值应用转换以匹配返回类型。

items.source: Iterating happens in the order of registration, so make sure to register more general types after specific ones.
items.translation: 迭代按注册顺序进行，因此请确保在特定类型之后注册更通用的类型。

Modifying queries are executed directly against the database.
No events or callbacks get called.
Therefore also fields with auditing annotations do not get updated if they don’t get updated in the annotated query.

对查询的修改会直接作用于数据库。  
不会触发任何事件或回调。  
因此，如果审计注解中的字段未在注解的查询中被更新，这些字段也不会被更新。

items.source: Declare a query method by using @Query

items.source: 1 The method shows a query for all people with the given firstname. The query is derived by parsing the method name for constraints that can be concatenated with And and Or. Thus, the method name results in a query expression of SELECT … FROM person WHERE firstname = :firstname. 2 Use Pageable to pass offset and sorting parameters to the database. 3 Return a Slice<Person>. Selects LIMIT+1 rows to determine whether there’s more data to consume. ResultSetExtractor customization is not supported. 4 Run a paginated query returning Page<Person>.Selects only data within the given page bounds and potentially a count query to determine the total count. ResultSetExtractor customization is not supported. 5 Find a single entity for the given criteria. It completes with IncorrectResultSizeDataAccessException on non-unique results. 6 In contrast to <5>, the first entity is always emitted even if the query yields more results. 7 The findByLastname method shows a query for all people with the given lastname. 8 The streamByLastname method returns a Stream, which makes values possible as soon as they are returned from the database. 9 You can use the Spring Expression Language to dynamically resolve parameters. In the sample, Spring Security is used to resolve the username of the current user.
items.translation: 1 该方法展示了查询所有具有给定 firstname 的人。该查询是通过解析方法名中的约束条件生成的，这些约束条件可以与 And 和 Or 连接。因此，方法名生成的查询表达式为 SELECT … FROM person WHERE firstname = :firstname。 2 使用 Pageable 将偏移量和排序参数传递给数据库。 3 返回一个 Slice<Person>。选择 LIMIT+1 行以确定是否还有更多数据需要消费。不支持 ResultSetExtractor 自定义。 4 运行分页查询，返回 Page<Person>。仅选择给定页面范围内的数据，并可能执行计数查询以确定总数。不支持 ResultSetExtractor 自定义。 5 根据给定条件查找单个实体。如果结果不唯一，将以 IncorrectResultSizeDataAccessException 完成。 6 与 <5> 相反，即使查询产生更多结果，也会始终发出第一个实体。 7 该方法展示了查询所有具有给定 lastname 的人。 8 该 streamByLastname 方法返回一个 Stream，使得值在从数据库返回后即可使用。 9 您可以使用 Spring 表达式语言动态解析参数。在示例中，使用 Spring Security 解析当前用户的用户名。

items.source: Using a custom RowMapper through QueryMappingConfiguration, @Query(rowMapperClass=…), or a custom ResultSetExtractor disables Entity Callbacks and Lifecycle Events as the result mapping can issue its own events/callbacks if needed.
items.translation: 通过 QueryMappingConfiguration 使用自定义的 RowMapper，或使用 @Query(rowMapperClass=…)，或自定义的 ResultSetExtractor，将禁用实体回调和生命周期事件，因为结果映射在需要时可以自行发出相应的事件/回调。

items.source: Note that String-based queries do not support pagination nor accept Sort, PageRequest, and Limit as a query parameter as for these queries the query would be required to be rewritten. If you want to apply limiting, please express this intent using SQL and bind the appropriate parameters to the query yourself.
items.translation: 请注意，基于字符串的查询不支持分页，也不接受 Sort、PageRequest 和 Limit 作为查询参数，因为这些查询需要重写。 如果您想应用限制，请使用 SQL 表达此意图，并自行将适当的参数绑定到查询中。

items.source: Spring fully supports Java 8’s parameter name discovery based on the -parameters compiler flag. By using this flag in your build as an alternative to debug information, you can omit the @Param annotation for named parameters.
items.translation: Spring 完全支持基于 -parameters 编译器标志的 Java 8 参数名发现功能。 在构建中使用此标志作为调试信息的替代方案，您可以省略命名参数的 @Param 注解。

items.source: Query derivation is limited to properties that can be used in a WHERE clause without using joins.
items.translation: 查询推导仅限于那些可以在不使用连接的情况下用于 WHERE 子句的属性。
